paths.GET /: Lidarr's web UI. cellarr serves its own UI on the main listener.
paths.GET /api: API discovery document; no client reads it.
paths.GET /login: Lidarr's UI login form; cellarr has its own web auth.
paths.POST /login: Lidarr's UI login form; cellarr has its own web auth.
paths.GET /logout: Lidarr's UI login form; cellarr has its own web auth.
paths.GET /feed/v1/calendar/lidarr.ics: iCal feed. cellarr serves /feed/v3/calendar for video; the music feed is not built yet.
paths.POST /api/v1/albumstudio: Bulk 'album studio' monitoring editor in Lidarr's UI. Use PUT /album/monitor or PUT /artist/editor.
paths.GET /api/v1/autotagging: Auto-tagging rules; cellarr has no equivalent.
paths.POST /api/v1/autotagging: Auto-tagging rules; cellarr has no equivalent.
paths.GET /api/v1/autotagging/schema: Auto-tagging rules; cellarr has no equivalent.
paths.GET /api/v1/autotagging/{id}: Auto-tagging rules; cellarr has no equivalent.
paths.PUT /api/v1/autotagging/{id}: Auto-tagging rules; cellarr has no equivalent.
paths.DELETE /api/v1/autotagging/{id}: Auto-tagging rules; cellarr has no equivalent.
paths.GET /api/v1/customfilter: Saved list filters in Lidarr's UI; cellarr's UI keeps its own.
paths.POST /api/v1/customfilter: Saved list filters in Lidarr's UI; cellarr's UI keeps its own.
paths.GET /api/v1/customfilter/{id}: Saved list filters in Lidarr's UI; cellarr's UI keeps its own.
paths.PUT /api/v1/customfilter/{id}: Saved list filters in Lidarr's UI; cellarr's UI keeps its own.
paths.DELETE /api/v1/customfilter/{id}: Saved list filters in Lidarr's UI; cellarr's UI keeps its own.
paths.GET /api/v1/filesystem: Folder browser behind Lidarr's UI path pickers.
paths.GET /api/v1/filesystem/mediafiles: Folder browser behind Lidarr's UI path pickers.
paths.GET /api/v1/filesystem/type: Folder browser behind Lidarr's UI path pickers.
paths.GET /api/v1/log/file/update/{filename}: Update logs; cellarr does not self-update.
paths.GET /api/v1/mediacover/album/{albumId}/{: Cover art. Resources carry the remote cover URL in images[].remoteUrl instead.
paths.GET /api/v1/mediacover/artist/{artistId}: Artist art. Not fetched yet (MusicBrainz carries none).
paths.GET /api/v1/search: Combined lookup used by Lidarr's UI search box. Use /artist/lookup and /album/lookup.
paths.POST /api/v1/system/restart: cellarr is restarted by its supervisor (systemd, Kubernetes); it does not restart itself.
paths.POST /api/v1/system/shutdown: cellarr is stopped by its supervisor (systemd, Kubernetes); it does not stop itself.
paths.GET /api/v1/tag/detail/{id}: Tag usage detail for Lidarr's UI.
paths.PUT /api/v1/delayprofile/reorder/{id}: Delay-profile ordering; cellarr orders by specificity.
paths.POST /api/v1/manualimport: Manual import of loose music files is not built yet; completed downloads import automatically.
paths.PUT /api/v1/trackfile/editor: Bulk quality editing of track files.
paths.PUT /api/v1/trackfile/{id}: Editing a track file's quality by hand.
paths.POST /api/v1/history/failed/{id}: Marking a history item failed. Remove it from the queue with blocklist=true instead.
paths.GET /api/v1/metadata: Metadata consumers (Kodi/Emby sidecar writers) for music are not built.
paths.POST /api/v1/metadata: Metadata consumers (Kodi/Emby sidecar writers) for music are not built.
paths.GET /api/v1/metadata/schema: Metadata consumers (Kodi/Emby sidecar writers) for music are not built.
paths.POST /api/v1/metadata/test: Metadata consumers (Kodi/Emby sidecar writers) for music are not built.
paths.POST /api/v1/metadata/testall: Metadata consumers (Kodi/Emby sidecar writers) for music are not built.
paths.POST /api/v1/metadata/action/{name}: Metadata consumers (Kodi/Emby sidecar writers) for music are not built.
paths.GET /api/v1/metadata/{id}: Metadata consumers (Kodi/Emby sidecar writers) for music are not built.
paths.PUT /api/v1/metadata/{id}: Metadata consumers (Kodi/Emby sidecar writers) for music are not built.
paths.DELETE /api/v1/metadata/{id}: Metadata consumers (Kodi/Emby sidecar writers) for music are not built.
paths.POST /api/v1/indexer/testall: Bulk connection test; Prowlarr tests indexers one at a time through /indexer/test.
paths.POST /api/v1/indexer/action/{name}: Provider-specific UI actions; none apply to Torznab/Newznab.
paths.POST /api/v1/importlist/test: Music import lists (Spotify, Last.fm, ...) are not built yet.
paths.POST /api/v1/importlist/testall: Music import lists are not built yet.
paths.POST /api/v1/importlist/action/{name}: Music import lists are not built yet.
